title: Kamianets-Podilskyi Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

note: The inspected aerial picture confirms the asymmetric Old Castle tower chain, two tall northern cones with warm crown bands, broad Papal cap, paired open western bastion and lower outer courts.
